repairs: Initial 34/38 unit result found four production version-6 codec failures. Explicit primitive wire identifiers and typed reconstruction replaced direct read-only struct deserialization. All 299 cases required new qualification; initial passes were not reused.

The codec-fixed candidate passed 79/81 before stopping. Two tests incorrectly reused a pre-join scope revision and ambiguously selected the child SQL. Only those two methods changed; the exact historical bridge was verified.

The next 220-case selection executed 177: 175 passed and two existing cancelled-result tests failed; 43 were not executed. The P13 guard inspected pending work before atomic result settlement. Production was repaired with a narrowly typed post-flush quiescence obligation, retaining early admission checks and throwing before commit if any independent work remains.

The repaired-production candidate passed 31/38: all original cases passed, while six new descendant cases used an expired fixture clock and one forged original was correctly refused earlier by optimistic concurrency. Only the test file changed. The affected 38-case class was repeated plus 274 unexecuted regressions, yielding 312 final passes without prior test-pass reuse. Exact production sources/binaries and five affected Release builds are bridged to the final Integration-only rebuild.
invariants: Terminal step and run outcomes remain unchanged; only accounting generation and runtime timestamp/version advance.
Persisted terminal step, live claim absence, exact generation/budget revision, complete retained children and settled allocations are checked under the existing root transaction.
No child, work, event, outbox or business effect is invented. Shared scope closure remains independently owned.
Original action and explicit actor determine replay identity. Receipt recovery precedes current-state checks.
Version 6 requires its exact shape; versions 1-5 retain their original representation.
One exact guard projection and a 65-row child bound avoid material payload hydration. No external callbacks run inside SQL ownership.

An original atomic cancelled strategy result can close its last child and root together only after full post-flush quiescence and persisted result acceptance. Other pending owners roll back the entire result, accounting and receipt; ordinary cancellation retains early refusal.
